name: triage_verify_verdict
description: exploitable|mitigated|needs_manual_test are the skill's canonical values; confirmed|refuted|hardening are accepted presentation aliases.

definitions.exploitable: The verification lens confirmed an exploitable finding.
definitions.mitigated: The real issue is mitigated or inapplicable here, distinct from a wrong claim.
definitions.needs_manual_test: A manual test is needed; no validity decision follows yet.
definitions.refuted: Accepted refutation presentation alias: the reported claim is wrong.
definitions.hardening: Historical presentation verdict for a real defense-in-depth weakness.

standard.none: Project-defined classifier vocabulary; existing meanings are retained.
